name: Athletics
overview: A career as an athlete is an exhilarating pursuit that involves pushing the boundaries of physical strength, speed, and endurance. Athletes compete across various sports while adhering to established rules, dedicating themselves to rigorous training under professional coaches. The field combines continuous training, physical conditioning, and honing skills with opportunities for personal growth and the pursuit of excellence.

topJobs.description: Professionals who help athletes improve mental well-being and competitive performance through mental resilience and stress management.
Officials ensuring fair play and enforcing rules during sports competitions.
Mentors guiding athletes to reach full potential through instruction and motivation.
Specialists in sports rehabilitation treating injuries and preventing future damage.

institutesIndia: Indira Gandhi Institute of Physical Education and Sports Sciences (IGIPESS)
Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE)
institutesInternational: University of Texas at Austin (United States)
careerLadder: Excel in chosen sport during high school with competitive training
Maintain strong academic record alongside athletic performance
Pursue undergraduate degrees in sports science, kinesiology, or related fields
Engage in internships and sports-related extracurricular activities
Continue postgraduate studies in sports management, coaching, or sports medicine
Develop specialized expertise and pursue advanced career opportunities
